```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)

library(sf)
library(caret)

Sys.getenv("CENSUS_API_KEY") != ""  
```

### The cross-validation helper

```{r}
#| label: cv-helper
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10)

cv_rmse <- function(formula, data) {
  df <- if (inherits(data, "sf")) st_drop_geometry(data) else data
  vars <- all.vars(formula)
  bad <- vars[sapply(vars, function(v) any(is.na(df[[v]])))]
  if (length(bad) > 0) {
    stop("These variables have NAs: ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "),
         ". Fill them or choose another variable (Rule 1: don't drop rows).")
  }
  set.seed(5080)
  fit <- train(formula, data = df, method = "lm", trControl = ctrl)
  fit$results$RMSE
}
```

### The model log



```{r}
#| label: log-start
model_log <- tibble(
  model   = character(),
  added   = character(),
  cv_rmse = numeric(),
  notes   = character()
)
```




```{r}
#| label: pull
cook_tracts <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  state = "IL",
  county = "Cook",
  variables = c(
    total_pop = "B01003_001",
    medincome = "B19013_001",
    ba = "B15003_022",
    ma = "B15003_023",
    prof = "B15003_024",
    phd = "B15003_025",
    popover25 = "B15003_001",
    vacant = "B25002_003",
    owner_occ   = "B25003_002",
    tenure_tot  = "B25003_001"
  ),
  year = 2023,
  output = "wide",
  geometry = TRUE
) %>%
  st_transform(3435)

```

```{r}

chicago <- get_acs(geography = "place", state = "IL",
                   variables = "B01003_001", year = 2023,
                   geometry = TRUE) %>%
  filter(NAME == "Chicago city, Illinois") %>%
  st_transform(3435)

nrow(chicago)


in_chicago <- st_intersects(st_point_on_surface(cook_tracts), chicago, sparse = FALSE)[, 1]
chi_tracts <- cook_tracts %>% filter(in_chicago)

```
```{r}
#education
chi_tracts = chi_tracts %>%
  mutate(
    edulevel = baE + maE + profE + phdE,
    edulevel_moe = sqrt(baM^2 + maM^2 + profM^2 + phdM^2),
    edulevelpct = edulevel / popover25E * 100,
    edulevelpct_moe = moe_prop(edulevel, popover25E, edulevel_moe, popover25M) * 100,
    edu_cv = (edulevelpct_moe / 1.645) / edulevelpct * 100
  )
#income
chi_tracts = chi_tracts %>%
  mutate(
    medinc_cv = (medincomeM / 1.645) / medincomeE * 100
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: load-join-split
chi_housesf = st_read("C:/cktportfolio/chicago-housing-price-challenge/all_sales.geojson") 

st_crs(chi_housesf)$epsg   
head(chi_housesf)         


chi_housesf = st_transform(chi_housesf, st_crs(chi_tracts))
chi_house_tracts = st_join(chi_housesf, chi_tracts, join = st_nearest_feature)

chi_house_tracts = chi_house_tracts %>%
  mutate(
    medincomeE = if_else(is.na(medincomeE),
                         median(medincomeE, na.rm = TRUE),
                         medincomeE),
    edulevelpct = if_else(is.na(edulevelpct),           # CHANGED: new fill
                          median(edulevelpct, na.rm = TRUE),
                          edulevelpct)
  )

sum(is.na(chi_house_tracts$GEOID))
sum(is.na(chi_house_tracts$medincomeE))
sum(is.na(chi_house_tracts$edulevelpct))   

chi_train = chi_house_tracts %>% filter(!is.na(sale_price))  

chi_test  = chi_house_tracts %>% filter(is.na(sale_price))    


nrow(chi_train)   
nrow(chi_test)
```

```{r}

#| label: load-all-sales
all_sales = st_read("C:/cktportfolio/chicago-housing-price-challenge/all_sales_complete (2).geojson")
n_before = nrow(all_sales)
n_before   # should be about 30,792; if it's ~2.4 million, this file was saved after the bad join

# Only pull tract variables that aren't already in the file (avoids .x/.y duplicates)
tract_vars = setdiff(c("vacantE", "edulevelpct", "medincomeE",
                       "owner_occE", "tenure_totE"),
                     names(all_sales))

all_sales = all_sales %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(chi_tracts)) %>%
  st_join(chi_tracts %>% select(all_of(tract_vars)), join = st_nearest_feature)

nrow(all_sales) == n_before   # must print TRUE

# Fill any NAs with the median (your cv_rmse helper won't run with NAs)
all_sales = all_sales %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(tract_vars), ~ if_else(is.na(.x), median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x)))

train_df = all_sales %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(split == "train") %>%
  mutate(across(c(year, sale_qrt, num_bedrooms, num_half_baths, num_fireplaces), as.factor))

nrow(train_df)

```
